_comment: Per-servo SAFE ranges for the physical MaxArm, loaded by tools/repl_relay.py to clamp every translated command. See docs/REAL_ARM_OPERATION.md.
_measured: 2026-06-07 via tools/arm_limits.py (get_position stall-finder, servos 1-3) and a wrist sweep (servo 4, nozzle.set_angle, open-loop PWM, no feedback). Each joint jogged from home in isolation. Servos 1-3 moved FREELY across wide caps with NO hard stall (base free 86-912, shoulder 304-695, elbow 484-735) -> these ranges carry inward margin and are well within the true mechanical limits; the firmware also clamps shoulder<=700 and elbow>=470. The wrist swept +/-80deg clean. These are PER-SERVO limits from home -- COMBINED poses can still collide with the table/itself (not measured).
_relax: idle_relax_sec: unload the 3 bus servos (arm.teaching_mode) after this many seconds with no joint move, so they never HOLD torque long enough to overheat. The next move re-loads them. 0 disables. Set higher for fewer sag cycles during slow sequences, lower for cooler running.
_z_floor: z_floor_mm is the real table-surface floor. src/armsim.rail MUST mirror it via the table_floor_mm accessor (A3/A8/C8 shared contract); below-floor poses are rejected HTTP 422 at every actuation chokepoint. Equals xyz.z[0].
